sources.entry: Lingarr - Automatically translate subtitle files in your Radarr and Sonarr media libraries, using LibreTranslate, local AI models, or SaaS translation services. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: Lingarr is a self-hosted app that automatically translates subtitle files in Radarr and Sonarr media libraries using LibreTranslate, AI models, or commercial translation services.
summary.what_it_does: Lingarr translates subtitle files into a chosen target language. It supports many translation backends, including LibreTranslate, a local AI option (Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible model/router), DeepL, Anthropic, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Mistral, xAI, Gemini, Google, Bing, Yandex, and Microsoft. It is distributed as Docker images for amd64 and arm64, and the README's compose and CLI examples mount movie and TV folders so it can work on media files. Its database can be MySQL (default), PostgreSQL, or SQLite, with Hangfire used for background jobs. It also exposes a RESTful API with Swagger documentation. An optional LibreTranslate container can be set up alongside it.
use_cases: Translate subtitles for Radarr movie libraries
Translate subtitles for Sonarr TV libraries
Run subtitle translation with a local LibreTranslate instance
Use a local AI model such as Ollama for subtitle translation
Automate subtitle translation through a REST API
Translate subtitles with DeepL or other cloud translation services
how_to_run: Create a docker-compose.yml with the lingarr service (image ghcr.io/lingarr-translate/lingarr:latest) and a MariaDB service, then set the DB_* environment variables and volume mounts for /movies, /tv, and /app/config
Start MariaDB with docker run, attached to the lingarr network
Start Lingarr with docker run, mapping port 9876:9876 and the same DB and volume settings
Optionally run LibreTranslate (libretranslate/libretranslate) on port 5000, setting LT_LOAD_ONLY to your languages
Open Lingarr on port 9876 and configure a translation service
notable: Supports many translation providers, including local LibreTranslate and AI models, through one interface
Integrates with Radarr and Sonarr media libraries
Multi-architecture Docker images for amd64 and arm64
Database choice between MySQL, PostgreSQL, and SQLite
Includes a RESTful API with Swagger documentation
caveats: Requires Docker and a separate database container for the default MySQL setup
Some translation services are paid SaaS options that need their own API accounts
